item.title: Apple Accused of Fraud Over iCloud Private Relay Flaw
item.description: A proposed class action alleges Apple misled iCloud+ users by marketing Private Relay as a privacy shield, despite known IP‑leaking flaws in Safari.

item.title: Apple iCloud Relay Flaw May Lead to Class Action
item.description: Researchers found a flaw in Apple’s iCloud Private Relay that leaks IP addresses, raising privacy alarms and paving the way for a class‑action suit.
